_comment: FIXTURE install config for definition-of-done. Synthetic values only; it is
what `fleet where definition-of-done config.json` resolves to when
runs the checker against it, and holds its key set equal to the skill's
config.example.json. The waivers and the permalink pattern are the ones
the skill's fixtures/ checklists are written against. permalink_pattern is
deliberately unanchored (no ^ or $): the checker FULL-matches it, and the
test's trailing-extra case can only prove that against an unanchored pattern.
